'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nick Reisch LS Let The Wookiee Win (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let The Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Let The Wookiee Win (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
